glosses: A valued possession that has been passed down through the generations.

examples.text: Morning rehearsal starts at eleven. Wheeler takes a taxi from the hotel to the venue, bringing his tuxedo and his violin with him. His violin is an heirloom, more than a hundred years old, and while he's touring it never leaves his sight. (His tuxedo is just a tuxedo.)

glosses: An old crop variety that has been passed down through generations of farmers by seed saving and cultivation, in contrast to modern cultivars used in large-scale agriculture.

examples.text: My last trip to the market barely yielded enough unmealy heirlooms for a couple of salads.
